_comment: The article before a number as it is said aloud ("an 8-second shot", "a 6-second shot"): eight, eleven, eighteen and the eighties start with a vowel sound, also as the first group of a larger number. Shared by internal/plainwords (TestAOrAnFollowsHowTheNumberIsSaid) and web/scripts/article-test.mjs (aOrAn in web/src/lib/format.ts), so Go and the dashboard agree.
